title: Assembly of the repeated ordinary geometric adjunction
statement: Given the geometric datum G and actual repetition packages RX and RY of [lem-coef-semilinear-derived-sections] and [lem-pur-system-block-constructions], let P be an OrdinaryInverseSystem [lem-coef-ordinary-inverse-system] on the repeated coefficient towers, with inverse images exactly G.inverseImage at t(m), and K an OrdinaryDirectSystemCore [lem-coef-ordinary-direct-system-core] using G.levelPush and G.levelAdjunction at t(m). Suppose δ:G.pull ⋙ RX.repetition ≅ RY.repetition ⋙ P.pull and s:RX.repetition ⋙ K.push ≅ G.push ⋙ RY.repetition are natural isomorphisms satisfying the normalized pull and push evaluation-square equations. Then there is an adjunction adj:P.pull ⊣ K.push, whose unit satisfies RY.map(G.unit) ≫ s.inv ≫ K.push.map(δ.hom) = adj.unit, and whose counit satisfies P.pull.map(s.inv) ≫ adj.counit = δ.inv ≫ RX.map(G.counit). No section-normalization hypothesis beyond the two evaluation-square equations, and no extra finite-limit hypothesis on uInv, is imposed.

proof.text: Apply the proved component Hom-equivalence assembly [lem-coef-ordinary-direct-system-hom-data] to P and K. By faithful ordinary evaluations and naturality of the component isomorphisms, the component Hom formulas prove both naturality laws. Adjunction.mkOfHomEquiv gives the ordinary adjunction. Its component transpose formula is the prescribed level-adjunction formula.

proof.text: For G of [lem-coef-semilinear-derived-sections], its normalized ordinary system unit shows that evaluating its Hom equivalence gives the specified level transpose. Conjugate the repeated pull square by its inverse and component isomorphisms. Apply this identity and the direct square equation to show that the new Hom equivalence commutes with the repetition functors of [lem-pur-system-block-constructions]. Faithful ordinary evaluations turn the component equality into a system equality. Applying this equality to an identity yields the unit square. Applying it to the original counit, and using injectivity of the new Hom equivalence and the adjunction identities, yields the counit square. These are completely proved Lean calculations.

lean.statement:
theorem blockGeometricAdjunctionAssembly :
    ∃ adj : P.pull ⊣ K.push,
      (∀ M : Systems J B₀ τ₀,
        RY.repetition.map (G.ordinaryAdjunction.unit.app M) ≫
            s.inv.app (G.pull.obj M) ≫ K.push.map (δ.hom.app M) =
          adj.unit.app (RY.repetition.obj M)) ∧
      (∀ N : Systems J' G.coefficients G.coefficientTransition,
        P.pull.map (s.inv.app N) ≫ adj.counit.app (RX.repetition.obj N) =
          δ.inv.app (G.push.obj N) ≫ RX.repetition.map (G.ordinaryAdjunction.counit.app N))
